AI.title_translation: 无线网络控制系统中传感器到控制器链路的卡尔曼滤波器与信道解码器的迭代联合检测
AI.tldr: 提出了一种用于无线控制系统链路的卡尔曼滤波器（KF）和信道解码器的迭代联合检测算法，该算法利用控制系统的先验信息，同时提高了通信的块错误率（BLER）和控制的均方根误差（RMSE）性能。
AI.motivation: 为了提高无线网络控制系统中传感器到控制器链路的控制和通信性能，本文提出了一种利用控制系统先验信息的迭代联合检测算法。
AI.method: 提出了一种卡尔曼滤波器（KF）与信道解码器的迭代联合检测算法。该算法首先使用KF估计控制系统输出的概率密度，并计算接收信号的先验概率以辅助解码器。随后，通过遍历控制系统的可能输出来更新先验概率，从而实现迭代检测。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，先验信息和迭代结构可以降低通信的块错误率（BLER）性能，同时改善控制的均方根误差（RMSE）性能。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的算法通过利用控制系统的先验信息和迭代结构，能够同时降低通信的块错误率（BLER）并提高控制的均方根误差（RMSE）性能。
AI.translation: 在这篇快报中，我们针对无线网络控制系统的传感器到控制器链路，提出了一种卡尔曼滤波器（KF）与信道解码器的迭代联合检测算法，该算法利用控制系统的先验信息来提高控制和通信性能。在该算法中，我们首先使用KF来估计控制系统输出的概率密度，并计算接收信号的先验概率以辅助解码器。然后，遍历控制系统的可能输出来更新先验概率，以实现迭代检测。仿真结果表明，先验信息和迭代结构可以降低通信的块错误率性能，同时改善控制的均方根误差性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对无线网络控制系统（WNCS）中传感器到控制器链路的迭代联合检测方案，集成了卡尔曼滤波器（KF）和信道解码器。该方法利用KF估计控制系统输出的概率密度作为先验信息辅助解码，并通过遍历系统可能输出来实现迭代优化。仿真验证了该方法能够有效降低通信的块错误率并提高控制的均方根误差性能。
AI.keywords: 迭代联合检测, 卡尔曼滤波器, 信道解码器, 无线网络控制系统, 先验信息
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于将控制理论的核心工具——卡尔曼滤波器（KF）与通信领域的信道解码器进行联合设计和迭代优化。这种跨层或跨域的联合检测方法，充分利用了控制系统本身的动态特性（先验信息），打破了传统通信和控制系统分离设计的局限性。在无线网络控制系统（WNCS）带宽和可靠性受限的背景下，这种紧密耦合的设计对于提升整体系统性能具有重要的实用价值。

title: A Multi-Language Perspective on the Robustness of LLM Code Generation
summary: Large language models have gained significant traction and popularity in recent times, extending their usage to code-generation tasks. While this field has garnered considerable attention, the exploration of testing and evaluating the robustness of code generation models remains an ongoing endeavor. Previous studies have primarily focused on code generation models specifically for the Python language, overlooking other widely-used programming languages. In this work, we conduct a comprehensive comparative analysis to assess the robustness performance of several prominent code generation models and investigate whether robustness can be improved by repairing perturbed docstrings using an LLM. Furthermore, we investigate how their performance varies across different programming languages. To accomplish this, we introduce perturbations in four key areas of the prompt: DocString, functionname, syntax, and format. We have compiled and released a dedicated dataset for this purpose. This work presents our experimental findings, shedding light on the performance of code generation models in various scenarios.

AI.title_translation: 大型语言模型代码生成鲁棒性的多语言视角
AI.tldr: 本文从多语言角度全面评估了大型语言模型代码生成的鲁棒性，通过引入提示扰动并探讨了LLM修复文档字符串的能力，揭示了模型在不同编程语言下的性能差异。
AI.motivation: 之前的研究主要集中在Python语言的代码生成模型，忽略了其他广泛使用的编程语言，并且对代码生成模型的鲁棒性测试和评估仍是一个持续的努力。
AI.method: 本文对几个主流代码生成模型的鲁棒性性能进行了全面的比较分析，并研究了通过使用LLM修复受扰动的文档字符串是否可以提高鲁棒性。研究了模型性能在不同编程语言中的变化。通过在提示的四个关键领域（文档字符串、函数名、语法和格式）引入扰动，并为此编译并发布了一个专用数据集。
AI.result: 本文展示了实验结果，揭示了代码生成模型在各种场景下的性能，以及它们的性能如何在不同编程语言中变化。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型近年来获得了显著的关注和普及，其用途已扩展到代码生成任务。尽管这一领域受到了广泛关注，但对代码生成模型鲁棒性的测试和评估仍是一个持续的努力。以往的研究主要集中在专门针对Python语言的代码生成模型，忽略了其他广泛使用的编程语言。在这项工作中，我们进行了一项全面的比较分析，以评估几个著名代码生成模型的鲁棒性性能，并研究是否可以通过使用大型语言模型修复受扰动的文档字符串来提高鲁棒性。此外，我们还研究了它们的性能在不同编程语言中如何变化。为了实现这一目标，我们在提示的四个关键领域引入了扰动：文档字符串、函数名、语法和格式。我们为此编译并发布了一个专用数据集。这项工作展示了我们的实验结果，揭示了代码生成模型在各种场景下的性能。
AI.summary: 本文从多语言视角探讨了大型语言模型（LLM）代码生成的鲁棒性。研究通过对现有主流代码生成模型进行全面比较分析，评估了其在多语言环境下的鲁棒性表现。研究方法包括在提示的文档字符串、函数名、语法和格式四个方面引入扰动，并探讨了LLM修复扰动文档字符串对鲁棒性的影响。为此，研究团队编译并发布了一个专用数据集。实验结果揭示了代码生成模型在不同场景和编程语言下的性能差异。
AI.keywords: LLM代码生成, 鲁棒性, 多语言, 提示扰动, 文档字符串
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于首次从多语言角度全面评估了LLM代码生成的鲁棒性，并探讨了LLM自身修复能力对鲁棒性的影响。通过引入多维度提示扰动和发布专用数据集，为后续研究提供了宝贵的资源和新的研究方向。其重要性在于填补了现有研究主要集中在Python语言的空白，推动了LLM代码生成在更广泛编程语言环境下的应用和发展。

title: Knowledge-Driven Agentic Scientific Corpus Distillation Framework for Biomedical Large Language Models Training
comments: Biomedical Large Language Models, Agentic Corpus Distillation, Synthetic Question-Answer Generation, Agentic AI, Knowledge Hierarchy Guidance
summary: Corpus distillation for biomedical large language models (LLMs) seeks to address the pressing challenge of insufficient quantity and quality in open-source annotated scientific corpora, which remains a bottleneck for effective LLM training in biomedical research. This paper proposes a knowledge-driven, agentic framework for scientific corpus distillation, tailored explicitly for LLM training in the biomedical domain, addressing the challenge posed by the complex hierarchy of biomedical knowledge. Central to our approach is a collaborative multi-agent architecture, where specialized agents, each guided by the Medical Subject Headings (MeSH) hierarchy, work in concert to autonomously extract, synthesize, and self-evaluate high-quality textual data from vast scientific literature. This agentic framework collectively generates and refines domain-specific question-answer pairs, ensuring comprehensive coverage and consistency with biomedical ontologies while minimizing manual involvement. Extensive experimental results show that language models trained on our multi-agent distilled datasets achieve notable improvements in biomedical question-answering tasks, outperforming both strong life sciences LLM baselines and advanced proprietary models. Notably, our AI-Ready dataset enables Llama3-70B to surpass GPT-4 with MedPrompt and Med-PaLM-2, despite their larger scale. Detailed ablation studies and case analyses further validate the effectiveness and synergy of each agent within the framework, highlighting the potential of multi-agent collaboration in biomedical LLM training.
comment: Biomedical Large Language Models, Agentic Corpus Distillation, Synthetic Question-Answer Generation, Agentic AI, Knowledge Hierarchy Guidance

AI.title_translation: 面向生物医学大型语言模型训练的知识驱动型主体科学语料蒸馏框架
AI.tldr: 针对生物医学LLM训练缺乏高质量语料的问题，本研究设计了一个多智能体知识驱动框架，利用MeSH结构自动从文献中“蒸馏”出高质量的问答数据。用这些数据训练的模型（如Llama3-70B）在生物医学问答测试中击败了GPT-4等更强大的模型。
AI.motivation: 解决生物医学大型语言模型（LLM）训练中开源带注释科学语料数量和质量不足的紧迫挑战，这是生物医学研究中有效LLM训练的瓶颈，尤其需要应对生物医学知识的复杂层次结构。
AI.method: 提出一个知识驱动、主体协作的科学语料蒸馏框架，采用多智能体协作架构。每个智能体都以医学主题词表（MeSH）层次结构为指导，协同工作以从海量科学文献中自主提取、综合和自我评估高质量文本数据，并生成和完善特定领域的问答对。
AI.result: 使用多智能体蒸馏数据集训练的语言模型在生物医学问答任务中实现了显著改进，性能优于强大的生命科学LLM基线和先进的专有模型。具体而言，基于AI-Ready数据集训练的Llama3-70B超越了GPT-4（使用MedPrompt）和Med-PaLM-2。消融研究验证了框架内每个智能体的有效性和协同作用。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的多智能体协作框架通过自主提取、综合和自评估生成并提炼了特定领域的问答对，确保了与生物医学本体的一致性，且显著减少了人工干预。在生物医学问答任务上，使用该框架蒸馏的数据集训练的模型表现出显著的改进，超越了现有的生命科学LLM基线和先进的专有模型。
AI.translation: 语料蒸馏旨在解决生物医学大型语言模型（LLM）训练中，开源带注释科学语料数量和质量不足的紧迫挑战，这仍然是生物医学研究中有效LLM训练的瓶颈。本文提出了一种知识驱动、主体协作的科学语料蒸馏框架，专门针对生物医学领域LLM训练，以应对生物医学知识复杂层次结构带来的挑战。我们方法的核心是协作式多智能体架构，其中每个智能体都以医学主题词表（MeSH）层次结构为指导，协同工作以自主地从海量科学文献中提取、综合和自我评估高质量的文本数据。该主体框架协同生成和完善特定领域的问答对，确保了对生物医学本体的全面覆盖和一致性，同时最大限度地减少了人工干预。广泛的实验结果表明，在我们的多智能体蒸馏数据集上训练的语言模型在生物医学问答任务中取得了显著的改进，性能超越了强大的生命科学LLM基线和先进的专有模型。值得注意的是，我们的AI-Ready数据集使Llama3-70B在性能上超越了GPT-4（使用MedPrompt）和Med-PaLM-2，尽管它们的规模更大。详细的消融研究和案例分析进一步验证了框架内每个智能体的有效性和协同作用，凸显了多智能体协作在生物医学LLM训练中的潜力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种面向生物医学大型语言模型训练的知识驱动、主体协作的科学语料蒸馏框架，以解决高质量语料稀缺的问题。该框架利用基于MeSH层次结构指导的协作多智能体架构，自动提取、综合和精炼高质量的领域特定问答对。实验证明，使用该蒸馏数据集训练的模型在生物医学问答任务上性能显著提升，甚至使Llama3-70B超越了GPT-4等大型专有模型。
AI.keywords: 语料蒸馏, 生物医学LLM, 多智能体框架, MeSH, 知识驱动
AI.comments: 该框架的创新点在于结合了知识驱动（基于MeSH层次结构）和主体协作（多智能体架构）来实现生物医学语料的蒸馏，有效解决了现有开放科学语料质量和数量不足的问题。其重要性在于，通过自动化、高质量的蒸馏，显著提升了LLM在生物医学问答任务上的性能，甚至超越了更大规模的专有模型。局限性可能在于框架的复杂性以及对MeSH层次结构依赖的程度。

title: Core-Set Selection for Data-efficient Land Cover Segmentation
summary: The increasing accessibility of remotely sensed data and their potential to support large-scale decision-making have driven the development of deep learning models for many Earth Observation tasks. Traditionally, such models rely on large datasets. However, the common assumption that larger training datasets lead to better performance tends to overlook issues related to data redundancy, noise, and the computational cost of processing massive datasets. Effective solutions must therefore consider not only the quantity but also the quality of data. Towards this, in this paper, we introduce six basic core-set selection approaches -- that rely on imagery only, labels only, or a combination of both -- and investigate whether they can identify high-quality subsets of data capable of maintaining -- or even surpassing -- the performance achieved when using full datasets for remote sensing semantic segmentation. We benchmark such approaches against two traditional baselines on three widely used land-cover classification datasets (DFC2022, Vaihingen, and Potsdam) using two different architectures (SegFormer and U-Net), thus establishing a general baseline for future works. Our experiments show that all proposed methods consistently outperform the baselines across multiple subset sizes, with some approaches even selecting core sets that surpass training on all available data. Notably, on DFC2022, a selected subset comprising only 25% of the training data yields slightly higher SegFormer performance than training with the entire dataset. This result shows the importance and potential of data-centric learning for the remote sensing domain. The code is available at https://github.com/keillernogueira/data-centric-rs-classification/.

AI.title_translation: 核心数据集选择用于数据高效的土地覆盖分割
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了六种核心数据集选择方法，用于从大规模遥感数据中选择高质量子集，以提高数据效率和模型性能。实验证明，这些方法在多个数据集和模型上均优于传统基线，并且某些核心集甚至能超越使用全部数据的性能。
AI.motivation: 传统深度学习模型通常需要大量数据，但忽略了数据冗余、噪声和计算成本问题。因此，需要关注数据质量而非仅仅数量，以实现更高效的模型训练。
AI.method: 提出并评估了六种仅依赖图像、仅依赖标签或结合两者进行核心数据集选择的方法。在DFC2022、Vaihingen和Potsdam三个数据集上，使用SegFormer和U-Net两种架构，并将所提方法与两种传统基线进行了比较。
AI.result: 所有提出的核心数据集选择方法在不同子集大小下均持续优于基线方法。在DFC2022数据集上，仅使用25%的训练数据就获得了比使用全部数据略高的SegFormer模型性能。
AI.conclusion: 核心数据集选择在遥感领域具有重要意义和潜力，能够通过选择高质量数据子集来提高模型性能并降低计算成本，实现数据高效学习。
AI.translation: 遥感数据的可及性日益提高，以及其在大规模决策支持方面的潜力，推动了许多地球观测任务的深度学习模型的发展。传统上，此类模型依赖于大型数据集。然而，训练数据集越大性能越好的普遍假设，往往忽略了数据冗余、噪声以及处理海量数据集的计算成本等问题。因此，有效的解决方案不仅要考虑数据的数量，还要考虑数据的质量。为此，在本文中，我们引入了六种基本的核心数据集选择方法——它们仅依赖图像、仅依赖标签或两者的组合——并研究它们是否能识别出高质量的数据子集，从而在遥感语义分割中使用全数据集所达到的性能，并保持甚至超越。我们在三个广泛使用的土地覆盖分类数据集（DFC2022、Vaihingen和Potsdam）上，使用两种不同的架构（SegFormer和U-Net），将此类方法与两种传统基线进行了基准测试，从而为未来的工作建立了一个通用基线。我们的实验表明，所有提出的方法在多个子集大小下均持续优于基线，其中一些方法甚至选择的核心集超越了在所有可用数据上进行训练。特别地，在DFC2022上，仅包含25%训练数据的选定子集比使用整个数据集的SegFormer性能略高。这一结果显示了以数据为中心学习在遥感领域的重要性和潜力。代码可在https://github.com/keillernogueira/data-centric-rs-classification/获得。
AI.summary: 本研究提出并评估了六种核心数据集选择方法，旨在通过识别高质量数据子集来提高遥感语义分割的效率和性能。实验结果表明，这些方法在不同数据集和模型上均表现出色，甚至能在仅使用部分数据的情况下超越使用全部数据的性能，证明了数据中心学习在遥感领域的价值。
AI.keywords: 核心数据集选择, 遥感分割, 数据效率, 深度学习, 土地覆盖分类
AI.comments: 该研究有效地解决了遥感数据处理中的数据冗余和计算成本问题，提出了一种新颖且实用的核心数据集选择方法。实验设计严谨，结果令人信服，为未来在遥感领域进行数据高效学习提供了坚实的基础。然而，未来可以进一步探索更复杂的核心集选择策略，并研究其在不同类型遥感任务和数据上的泛化能力。

title: Automating Automotive Software Development: A Synergy of Generative AI and Model-Based Methods
summary: As the automotive industry shifts its focus toward software-defined vehicles, the need for faster and reliable software development continues to grow. However, traditional methods show their limitations. The rise of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI), particularly Large Language Models (LLMs), introduces new opportunities to automate automotive software development tasks such as requirement analysis and code generation. However, due to the complexity of automotive systems, where software components must interact with each other seamlessly, challenges remain in software integration and system-level validation. In this paper, we propose to combine GenAI with model-driven engineering to automate automotive software development. Our approach uses LLMs to convert free-text requirements into event chain descriptions and to generate platform-independent software components that realize the required functionality. At the same time, formal models are created based on event chain descriptions to support system validation and the generation of integration code for integrating generated software components in the whole vehicle system through middleware. This approach increases development automation while enabling formal analysis to improve system reliability. As a proof of concept, we used GPT-4o to implement our method and tested it in the CARLA simulation environment with ROS2 middleware. We evaluated the system in a simple Autonomous Emergency Braking scenario.

AI.title_translation: 汽车软件开发的自动化：生成式人工智能与模型驱动方法的协同作用
AI.tldr: 将生成式AI（LLM）与模型驱动工程相结合，以自动化汽车软件开发，实现从文本需求到可执行代码的转换，并通过形式化模型进行验证，以提高可靠性。
AI.motivation: 汽车行业正转向软件定义汽车，对更快、更可靠的软件开发的需求日益增长，但传统方法存在局限性。生成式AI（特别是LLM）为自动化汽车软件开发任务提供了新机遇。
AI.method: 利用LLM将自由文本需求转换为事件链描述，并生成实现所需功能的平台无关软件组件。同时，基于事件链描述创建形式化模型，以支持系统验证和生成集成代码，通过中间件将生成的软件组件集成到整个车辆系统中。
AI.result: 在CARLA仿真环境中，使用GPT-4o和ROS2中间件，在简单的自主紧急制动场景中成功实现了该方法，证明了其可行性。
AI.conclusion: 结合生成式AI和模型驱动工程的方法，可以提高汽车软件开发的自动化程度，并通过形式化分析提高系统可靠性。
AI.translation: 随着汽车行业将其重点转向软件定义的汽车，对更快、更可靠的软件开发的需求持续增长。然而，传统方法显示出其局限性。生成式人工智能（GenAI）的兴起，特别是大型语言模型（LLM），为自动化汽车软件开发任务（如需求分析和代码生成）带来了新的机遇。然而，由于汽车系统的复杂性，软件组件必须无缝交互，因此在软件集成和系统级验证方面仍然存在挑战。在本文中，我们提出将GenAI与模型驱动工程相结合，以自动化汽车软件开发。我们的方法使用LLM将自由文本需求转换为事件链描述，并生成实现所需功能的平台无关软件组件。同时，基于事件链描述创建形式化模型，以支持系统验证和生成集成代码，通过中间件将生成的软件组件集成到整个车辆系统中。这种方法提高了开发自动化程度，同时支持形式化分析以提高系统可靠性。作为概念验证，我们使用GPT-4o实现了我们的方法，并在CARLA仿真环境中，使用ROS2中间件进行了测试。我们在一个简单的自主紧急制动场景中评估了该系统。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种结合生成式AI（特别是LLM）和模型驱动工程的方法，旨在自动化汽车软件开发过程。该方法利用LLM将非结构化的文本需求转化为结构化的事件链描述，并自动生成实现这些需求的平台无关软件组件。同时，利用事件链描述构建形式化模型，用于系统验证和生成将这些组件集成到车辆整体系统中的代码。通过在自主紧急制动场景下的概念验证，表明该方法能够提高开发自动化水平并增强系统可靠性。
AI.keywords: 生成式AI, 模型驱动工程, 汽车软件开发, 大型语言模型, 形式化验证
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地结合了最新的生成式AI技术和成熟的模型驱动工程方法，为解决汽车软件开发中的复杂性和效率问题提供了一个有前景的解决方案。利用LLM处理需求和生成代码，同时使用形式化模型进行验证，有望显著提高开发速度和软件质量。然而，在更复杂的真实世界场景中进行大规模部署和验证仍是未来的挑战。

title: CogniSNN: An Exploration to Random Graph Architecture based Spiking Neural Networks with Enhanced Depth-Scalability and Path-Plasticity
summary: Currently, most spiking neural networks (SNNs) still mimic the chain-like hierarchical architecture in traditional artificial neural networks (ANNs). This method significantly differs from random connections between neurons found in biological brains, limiting the ability to model the evolving mechanisms of neural pathways in biological neural systems, particularly in terms of dynamic depth-scalability and adaptive path-plasticity. This paper develops a new modeling paradigm for SNNs with random graph architecture (RGA), termed Cognition-aware SNN (CogniSNN). Furthermore, we model the depth-scalability and path-plasticity in CogniSNN by introducing a modified spiking residual neural node (ResNode) to counteract network degradation in deeper graph pathways, as well as a critical path-based algorithm that enables CogniSNN to perform path reusability on new tasks leveraging the features of the data and the RGA learned in old tasks. Experiments show that the performance of CogniSNN with redesigned ResNode is comparable, even superior, to current state-of-the-art SNNs on neuromorphic datasets. The critical path-based approach effectively achieves path reuse capability while maintaining expected performance in learning new tasks that are similar to or distinct from the old ones. This study showcases the potential of RGA-based SNNs and paves a new path for modeling the fusion of computational neuroscience and deep intelligent agents. The code is available at github.com/Yongsheng124/CogniSNN.

AI.title_translation: 认知SNN：一种基于随机图架构的脉冲神经网络探索，具有增强的深度可扩展性和路径可塑性
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为CogniSNN的新型脉冲神经网络（SNN）模型，采用随机图架构（RGA）而非传统的链式结构。CogniSNN通过引入改进的残差节点（ResNode）来解决深度网络中的退化问题，并利用基于关键路径的算法实现路径重用，以适应新任务。实验表明，CogniSNN在神经形态数据集上的性能与最先进的SNN相当甚至更优，并成功实现了路径重用能力。
AI.motivation: 当前大多数SNN模仿传统ANN的链式层级结构，这与生物大脑中神经元间的随机连接不同，限制了SNN模拟神经通路演化机制的能力，尤其是在深度可扩展性和路径可塑性方面。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为CogniSNN的新型SNN模型，采用随机图架构（RGA）。通过引入改进的残差节点（ResNode）来解决深度网络中的退化问题，并设计了一种基于关键路径的算法来实现路径重用，以适应新任务。
AI.result: CogniSNN在神经形态数据集上的性能与当前最先进的SNN相当甚至更优。基于关键路径的方法成功实现了路径重用能力，同时在学习新任务时保持了预期性能。
AI.conclusion: 该研究展示了基于RGA的SNN的潜力，并为模拟计算神经科学与深度智能体的融合开辟了一条新途径。
AI.translation: 目前，大多数脉冲神经网络（SNN）仍然模仿传统人工神经网络（ANN）的链式层级结构。这种方法与生物大脑中神经元之间的随机连接显著不同，限制了模拟神经通路演化机制的能力，特别是在动态深度可扩展性和自适应路径可塑性方面。本文开发了一种具有随机图架构（RGA）的SNN新建模范式，称为认知感知SNN（CogniSNN）。此外，我们通过引入改进的脉冲残差神经网络节点（ResNode）来抵消更深层图路径中的网络退化，并引入一种基于关键路径的算法，使CogniSNN能够利用旧任务中学习到的数据特征和RGA来执行新任务的路径可重用性。实验表明，具有重新设计的ResNode的CogniSNN在神经形态数据集上的性能与当前最先进的SNN相当，甚至更优。基于关键路径的方法有效地实现了路径重用能力，同时在学习新任务时保持了预期的性能。这项研究展示了基于RGA的SNN的潜力，并为模拟计算神经科学与深度智能体的融合开辟了一条新途径。代码可在github.com/Yongsheng124/CogniSNN上获取。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为CogniSNN的新型脉冲神经网络（SNN）模型，其特点是采用了随机图架构（RGA）而非传统的链式结构。为了解决深度网络中的退化问题并增强模型的可扩展性，研究人员引入了一种改进的残差节点（ResNode）。此外，通过一种基于关键路径的算法，CogniSNN能够实现路径重用，从而在学习新任务时利用旧任务的经验。实验结果表明，CogniSNN在性能上可以媲美甚至超越现有的先进SNN模型，并有效实现了路径重用能力，为计算神经科学与深度智能体的融合提供了新的思路。
AI.keywords: 脉冲神经网络, 随机图架构, 深度可扩展性, 路径可塑性, 关键路径
AI.comments: 该研究在SNN架构上进行了创新，引入了随机图架构（RGA）并解决了深度网络中的关键问题，如网络退化和路径可塑性。ResNode和基于关键路径的算法是该方法的亮点，在保持性能的同时实现了路径重用。然而，抽象中未详细说明RGA的具体优势，以及在不同类型任务上的泛化能力。代码的公开是一个积极的方面。

title: Unleashing Humanoid Reaching Potential via Real-world-Ready Skill Space
summary: Humans possess a large reachable space in the 3D world, enabling interaction with objects at varying heights and distances. However, realizing such large-space reaching on humanoids is a complex whole-body control problem and requires the robot to master diverse skills simultaneously-including base positioning and reorientation, height and body posture adjustments, and end-effector pose control. Learning from scratch often leads to optimization difficulty and poor sim2real transferability. To address this challenge, we propose Real-world-Ready Skill Space (R2S2). Our approach begins with a carefully designed skill library consisting of real-world-ready primitive skills. We ensure optimal performance and robust sim2real transfer through individual skill tuning and sim2real evaluation. These skills are then ensembled into a unified latent space, serving as a structured prior that helps task execution in an efficient and sim2real transferable manner. A high-level planner, trained to sample skills from this space, enables the robot to accomplish real-world goal-reaching tasks. We demonstrate zero-shot sim2real transfer and validate R2S2 in multiple challenging goal-reaching scenarios.

AI.title_translation: 通过面向现实世界的技能空间释放人形机器人的抓取潜力
AI.tldr: 为了让人形机器人实现像人类一样的大空间抓取能力，研究人员提出了R2S2方法，它预先准备并优化了一组核心技能，将它们打包成一个易于使用的潜在空间，然后让一个规划器从中挑选技能来完成现实世界中的抓取任务，实现了无需额外训练的现实世界应用。
AI.motivation: 人类在三维世界中具有很大的可达空间，但实现人形机器人的大空间抓取是一个复杂的全身控制问题，需要同时掌握基础定位、姿态调整和末端执行器控制等多样技能，且从头学习容易导致优化困难和差的仿真到现实（sim2real）迁移性。
AI.method: 提出Real-world-Ready Skill Space (R2S2)，它首先建立一个包含现实世界准备好的原语技能的技能库，通过单独的技能调优和仿真到现实评估确保性能和迁移能力。然后，这些技能被集成到一个统一的潜在空间中，作为结构化先验。最后，训练一个高层规划器从该空间中采样技能以完成目标抓取任务。
AI.result: R2S2在多个具有挑战性的目标抓取场景中实现了零样本的仿真到现实（sim2real）迁移。
AI.conclusion: R2S2通过利用现实世界准备好的原语技能库，将其集成到统一的潜在空间中，并使用高层规划器从中采样技能，成功地使人形机器人在多个具有挑战性的目标抓取场景中实现了零样本的仿真到现实的迁移。
AI.translation: 人类在三维世界中拥有很大的可达空间，能够与不同高度和距离的物体进行交互。然而，在人形机器人上实现这种大空间抓取是一个复杂的全身控制问题，要求机器人同时掌握各种技能——包括基础定位和再定向、高度和身体姿态调整，以及末端执行器姿态控制。从头学习通常会导致优化困难和较差的仿真到现实（sim2real）迁移能力。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了现实世界准备好的技能空间（R2S2）。我们的方法首先从一个精心设计的包含现实世界准备好的原始技能的技能库开始。我们通过单独的技能调优和仿真到现实评估来确保最佳性能和稳健的sim2real迁移。然后，这些技能被集成到一个统一的潜在空间中，作为结构化先验，以高效且可迁移的方式帮助任务执行。一个旨在从该空间中采样的更高层规划器，使机器人能够完成现实世界的目标抓取任务。我们演示了零样本的sim2real迁移，并在多个具有挑战性的目标抓取场景中验证了R2S2。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Real-world-Ready Skill Space (R2S2) 框架，旨在解决人形机器人在大空间抓取任务中面临的复杂全身控制和仿真到现实迁移难题。R2S2首先构建了一个经过单独调优以确保现实世界性能和迁移能力的原始技能库，然后将这些技能整合到一个统一的潜在空间作为结构化先验。高层规划器利用这个先验空间中的技能来高效地完成目标抓取任务，并在实际环境中展示了零样本的成功迁移。
AI.keywords: 人形机器人, 技能空间, 目标抓取, 仿真到现实, 全身控制
AI.comments: 该方法通过构建预先调优的、为现实世界准备的原语技能库，并将其集成到一个统一的潜在空间中，有效地解决了人形机器人大空间抓取任务中复杂的全身控制和仿真到现实（sim2real）的迁移问题。其创新点在于将技能分解、调优和集成到结构化先验中，从而实现了零样本的现实世界迁移。

title: Reinforcement Learning Finetunes Small Subnetworks in Large Language Models
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) yields substantial improvements in large language models (LLMs) downstream task performance and alignment with human values. Surprisingly, such large gains result from updating only a small subnetwork comprising just 5 percent to 30 percent of the parameters, with the rest effectively unchanged. We refer to this phenomenon as parameter update sparsity induced by RL. It is observed across all 7 widely used RL algorithms (e.g., PPO, GRPO, DPO) and all 10 LLMs from different families in our experiments. This sparsity is intrinsic and occurs without any explicit sparsity promoting regularizations or architectural constraints. Finetuning the subnetwork alone recovers the test accuracy, and, remarkably, produces a model nearly identical to the one obtained via full finetuning. The subnetworks from different random seeds, training data, and even RL algorithms show substantially greater overlap than expected by chance. Our analysis suggests that this sparsity is not due to updating only a subset of layers, instead, nearly all parameter matrices receive similarly sparse updates. Moreover, the updates to almost all parameter matrices are nearly full-rank, suggesting RL updates a small subset of parameters that nevertheless span almost the full subspaces that the parameter matrices can represent. We conjecture that the this update sparsity can be primarily attributed to training on data that is near the policy distribution, techniques that encourage the policy to remain close to the pretrained model, such as the KL regularization and gradient clipping, have limited impact.

AI.title_translation: 大型语言模型中强化学习微调小子网络
AI.tldr: 研究发现，在大型语言模型（LLMs）的下游任务性能和人类价值观对齐方面，强化学习（RL）的改进主要来自于更新仅占参数5%到30%的一小部分子网络，而其余参数基本保持不变。这种被称为“RL诱导的参数更新稀疏性”的现象在多种RL算法和LLM家族中普遍存在，并且是内在的。单独微调这个子网络就能恢复测试准确性，并且效果与完全微调几乎相同。不同随机种子、训练数据甚至RL算法得出的子网络之间存在高度重叠。分析表明，这种稀疏性并非源于更新特定层，而是几乎所有参数矩阵都接收到稀疏更新，且更新接近全秩，表明RL更新了参数矩阵能表示的几乎全部子空间中的一小部分参数。研究推测，这种更新稀疏性可能归因于在接近策略分布的数据上进行训练，并且KL正则化和梯度裁剪等鼓励策略接近预训练模型的技巧影响有限。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在下游任务性能和人类价值观对齐方面，通过强化学习（RL）能够获得显著的改进。然而，这些改进的机制尚不完全清楚，特别是为什么只有一小部分参数的更新就能带来如此大的性能提升。
AI.method: 通过实验观察和分析，研究了RL在LLMs微调过程中参数更新的稀疏性现象。实验覆盖了7种常用的RL算法和10种不同家族的LLMs。分析了子网络的恢复能力、子网络之间的重叠度、更新稀疏性的来源（层级 vs. 矩阵内）、更新的秩以及可能导致稀疏性的原因（如训练数据分布和正则化技术）。
AI.result: 研究发现，RL在LLMs微调中仅更新5%-30%的参数子网络就能带来显著的性能提升和价值对齐，且效果接近完全微调。这种参数更新稀疏性是普遍存在的，并且子网络之间具有高度重叠性。稀疏性并非源于特定层，而是几乎所有参数矩阵都接收到稀疏但接近全秩的更新。KL正则化和梯度裁剪等技术对这种稀疏性的影响有限。
AI.conclusion: 强化学习在大型语言模型微调中表现出显著的参数更新稀疏性，即仅更新一小部分参数子网络即可获得接近完全微调的性能。这种现象是普遍的、内在的，并且子网络具有高度重叠性。研究推测，这种稀疏性可能与训练数据分布以及RL算法本身的特性有关，而非显式的正则化或架构约束。
AI.translation: 强化学习（RL）在大型语言模型（LLMs）的下游任务性能和与人类价值观的对齐方面取得了显著的改进。令人惊讶的是，如此巨大的收益来自于仅更新一个仅占参数5%到30%的小子网络，而其余参数基本保持不变。我们将这种现象称为RL诱导的参数更新稀疏性。它在我们实验中的所有7种广泛使用的RL算法（例如，PPO、GRPO、DPO）和所有10种来自不同家族的LLMs中都有观察到。这种稀疏性是内在的，并且在没有任何明确的促进稀疏性的正则化或架构约束的情况下发生。仅微调该小子网络即可恢复测试准确性，并且值得注意的是，它产生的模型与通过完全微调获得模型几乎相同。来自不同随机种子、训练数据甚至RL算法的子网络显示出比偶然预期更大的重叠。我们的分析表明，这种稀疏性并非由于仅更新子集层，而是几乎所有参数矩阵都接收到相似的稀疏更新。此外，几乎所有参数矩阵的更新都接近全秩，这表明RL更新了参数矩阵可以表示的几乎全部子空间中的一小部分参数。我们推测，这种更新稀疏性主要可归因于在接近策略分布的数据上进行训练，并且诸如KL正则化和梯度裁剪等鼓励策略保持接近预训练模型的技术影响有限。
AI.summary: 本研究揭示了强化学习（RL）在微调大型语言模型（LLMs）时的一个关键现象：参数更新稀疏性。研究发现，仅需更新5%-30%的参数子网络即可实现显著的性能提升和价值对齐，其效果与完全微调相当。这种稀疏性普遍存在于多种RL算法和LLM中，并且是模型内在的特性。分析表明，更新的参数虽然数量少，但占据了参数矩阵表示的几乎全部子空间。研究认为，这一现象可能与在接近策略分布的数据上进行训练有关，而非显式的正则化技术。
AI.keywords: 强化学习,大型语言模型,参数更新稀疏性,子网络微调,模型对齐
AI.comments: 这项研究揭示了RL在LLM微调中的一个令人惊讶且重要的现象——参数更新稀疏性。其创新性在于发现了仅需更新一小部分参数即可获得巨大收益，这为未来LLM的训练和部署提供了新的思路，可能大大降低计算成本和时间。研究的普遍性和内在性也增加了其可信度。然而，关于稀疏性原因的推测仍需进一步的实证研究来验证。

title: A Token is Worth over 1,000 Tokens: Efficient Knowledge Distillation through Low-Rank Clone
summary: Training high-performing Small Language Models (SLMs) remains costly, even with knowledge distillation and pruning from larger teacher models. Existing work often faces three key challenges: (1) information loss from hard pruning, (2) inefficient alignment of representations, and (3) underutilization of informative activations, particularly from Feed-Forward Networks (FFNs). To address these challenges, we introduce Low-Rank Clone (LRC), an efficient pre-training method that constructs SLMs aspiring to behavioral equivalence with strong teacher models. LRC trains a set of low-rank projection matrices that jointly enable soft pruning by compressing teacher weights, and activation clone by aligning student activations, including FFN signals, with those of the teacher. This unified design maximizes knowledge transfer while removing the need for explicit alignment modules. Extensive experiments with open-source teachers (e.g., Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-3B/7B-Instruct) show that LRC matches or surpasses state-of-the-art models trained on trillions of tokens--while using only 20B tokens, achieving over 1,000x training efficiency. Our codes and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/CURRENTF/LowRankClone and https://huggingface.co/collections/JitaiHao/low-rank-clone-lrc-6828389e96a93f1d4219dfaf.

AI.title_translation: 低秩克隆：一种比1000个Token更有价值的Token：高效知识蒸馏
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为低秩克隆（LRC）的高效知识蒸馏方法，通过训练低秩投影矩阵来实现软剪枝和激活克隆，从而使小型语言模型（SLM）在显著减少训练数据（200亿Token）的情况下，达到或超越在万亿Token上训练的先进模型的性能，实现了超过1000倍的训练效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的知识蒸馏和剪枝方法在训练高性能小型语言模型（SLM）时面临信息损失、表示不对齐和前馈网络（FFN）激活利用不足等挑战。
AI.method: LRC通过训练一组低秩投影矩阵，实现对教师模型权重的压缩（软剪枝），并对齐学生和教师模型的激活（包括FFN信号），从而在不使用显式对齐模块的情况下最大化知识转移。
AI.result: 在200亿Token的训练数据上，LRC模型在性能上匹配或超越了在万亿Token上训练的先进模型，实现了超过1000倍的训练效率。
AI.conclusion: LRC是一种高效的知识蒸馏方法，能够显著提高训练效率，使小型语言模型在有限的数据下达到先进水平。
AI.translation: 训练高性能的小型语言模型（SLM）仍然成本高昂，即使是从大型教师模型进行知识蒸馏和剪枝。现有工作通常面临三个关键挑战：（1）硬剪枝带来的信息损失，（2）表示不对齐的效率低下，以及（3）信息性激活（尤其是来自前馈网络（FFN）的激活）的利用不足。为了应对这些挑战，我们引入了低秩克隆（LRC），一种高效的预训练方法，旨在构建与强大教师模型行为等同的SLM。LRC训练了一组低秩投影矩阵，这些矩阵共同通过压缩教师权重来实现软剪枝，并通过对齐学生激活（包括FFN信号）与教师激活来实现激活克隆。这种统一的设计最大化了知识转移，同时无需显式对齐模块。与开源教师模型（例如，Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-3B/7B-Instruct）进行的广泛实验表明，LRC在仅使用20B Token的情况下，匹配或超越了在万亿Token上训练的最先进模型，实现了超过1000倍的训练效率。我们的代码和模型检查点可在https://github.com/CURRENTF/LowRankClone 和 https://huggingface.co/collections/JitaiHao/low-rank-clone-lrc-6828389e96a93f1d4219dfaf 获得。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为低秩克隆（LRC）的新型知识蒸馏方法，旨在高效地训练小型语言模型（SLM）。LRC通过训练低秩投影矩阵，同时实现对教师模型权重的软剪枝和激活信号的对齐，有效解决了现有方法中的信息损失、表示不对齐和激活利用不足等问题。实验证明，LRC在极少量的训练数据（20B Token）上，能够达到甚至超越在海量数据（万亿Token）上训练的先进模型的性能，实现了超过1000倍的训练效率。
AI.keywords: 知识蒸馏,小型语言模型,低秩克隆,高效预训练,模型压缩
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的知识蒸馏方法LRC，通过低秩克隆技术有效解决了训练小型语言模型（SLM）的效率和性能瓶颈。其核心亮点在于统一了软剪枝和激活对齐，并显著减少了训练数据需求，实现了惊人的训练效率提升。代码和模型的公开为该方法的进一步研究和应用奠定了基础。

title: Enter the Void - Planning to Seek Entropy When Reward is Scarce
summary: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) offers an intuitive way to increase the sample efficiency of model-free RL methods by simultaneously training a world model that learns to predict the future. These models constitute the large majority of training compute and time and they are subsequently used to train actors entirely in simulation, but once this is done they are quickly discarded. We show in this work that utilising these models at inference time can significantly boost sample efficiency. We propose a novel approach that anticipates and actively seeks out informative states using the world model's short-horizon latent predictions, offering a principled alternative to traditional curiosity-driven methods that chase outdated estimates of high uncertainty states. While many model predictive control (MPC) based methods offer similar alternatives, they typically lack commitment, synthesising multiple multi-step plans at every step. To mitigate this, we present a hierarchical planner that dynamically decides when to replan, planning horizon length, and the commitment to searching entropy. While our method can theoretically be applied to any model that trains its own actors with solely model generated data, we have applied it to Dreamer to illustrate the concept. Our method finishes MiniWorld's procedurally generated mazes 50% faster than base Dreamer at convergence and in only 60% of the environment steps that base Dreamer's policy needs; it displays reasoned exploratory behaviour in Crafter, achieves the same reward as base Dreamer in a third of the steps; planning tends to improve sample efficiency on DeepMind Control tasks.

AI.title_translation: 进入虚无——当奖励稀缺时，规划去寻求熵
AI.tldr: 不要丢弃训练好的世界模型！在推理时用它来主动寻找有趣的状态（熵），可以显著提高MBRL的样本效率，比基础Dreamer更快收敛且步数更少。
AI.motivation: 模型在模型基础强化学习（MBRL）中占据了大量的计算资源，但训练完成后很快被丢弃。动机在于探索在推理时利用这些世界模型，以显著提高样本效率。
AI.method: 提出了一种新方法，利用世界模型的短视潜在预测，主动寻找信息性状态。引入了一个层次规划器，动态决定何时重新规划、规划的视野长度以及对搜索熵的承诺，以解决传统MPC缺乏承诺的问题。该方法应用于Dreamer框架。
AI.result: 在MiniWorld中，该方法使收敛速度比基线Dreamer快50%，且仅需Dreamer所需环境步数的60%。在Crafter中，表现出合理的探索行为，并以Dreamer三分之一的步骤达到了相同的奖励。在DeepMind Control任务上，规划也倾向于提高样本效率。
AI.conclusion: 在MiniWorld、Crafter和DeepMind Control任务上，利用世界模型在推理时主动寻求熵（信息状态）的方法显著提高了样本效率，优于基线Dreamer。
AI.translation: 模型基础强化学习（MBRL）提供了一种直观的方式，通过同时训练一个学习预测未来的世界模型来提高无模型强化学习方法的样本效率。这些模型构成了绝大部分的训练计算和时间，随后它们被用来完全在模拟中训练Actor，但一旦完成后，它们很快就被丢弃了。我们在这项工作中表明，在推理时利用这些模型可以显著提高样本效率。我们提出了一种新颖的方法，利用世界模型的短视潜在预测来预期并主动寻找信息性状态，为追逐高不确定性状态的过时估计的传统好奇心驱动方法提供了一个原则性的替代方案。虽然许多基于模型预测控制（MPC）的方法提供了类似的替代方案，但它们通常缺乏承诺，在每一步合成多个多步计划。为减轻此问题，我们提出了一个层次规划器，动态决定何时重新规划、规划的视野长度以及对搜索熵的承诺。虽然我们的方法理论上可以应用于任何仅使用模型生成数据训练其Actor的模型，但我们将其应用于Dreamer以说明该概念。我们的方法在MiniWorld的过程生成迷宫中比基线Dreamer收敛速度快50%，且仅需基线Dreamer所需环境步数的60%；它在Crafter中显示出合理的探索行为，在三分之一的步骤内达到了与基线Dreamer相同的奖励；规划倾向于提高DeepMind Control任务的样本效率。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种在推理时利用模型基础强化学习（MBRL）中训练的世界模型的方法，以提高样本效率。该方法通过世界模型的短期预测主动寻找信息性状态，并引入了一个层次规划器来动态管理规划的深度和承诺，以克服传统MPC的不足。实验证明，该方法在多个环境中显著提高了样本效率。
AI.keywords: 模型预测控制, 样本效率, 世界模型, 主动探索, 层次规划
AI.comments: 该方法创新性地在推理时利用世界模型进行信息性状态的搜索，提供了一种比传统好奇心驱动方法更具原则性的替代方案。其核心贡献在于动态规划器，它解决了MPC方法中规划缺乏承诺的问题。限制在于主要在Dreamer框架下进行了验证。

title: MoAPT: Mixture of Adversarial Prompt Tuning for Vision-Language Models
summary: Large pre-trained Vision Language Models (VLMs) demonstrate excellent generalization capabilities but remain highly susceptible to adversarial examples, posing potential security risks. To improve the robustness of VLMs against adversarial examples, adversarial prompt tuning methods are proposed to align the text feature with the adversarial image feature without changing model parameters. However, when facing various adversarial attacks, a single learnable text prompt has insufficient generalization to align well with all adversarial image features, which ultimately results in overfitting. To address the above challenge, in this paper, we empirically find that increasing the number of learned prompts yields greater robustness improvements than simply extending the length of a single prompt. Building on this observation, we propose an adversarial tuning method named \textbf{Mixture of Adversarial Prompt Tuning (MoAPT)} to enhance the generalization against various adversarial attacks for VLMs. MoAPT aims to learn mixture text prompts to obtain more robust text features. To further enhance the adaptability, we propose a conditional weight router based on the adversarial images to predict the mixture weights of multiple learned prompts, which helps obtain sample-specific mixture text features aligning with different adversarial image features. Extensive experiments across 11 datasets under different settings show that our method can achieve better adversarial robustness than state-of-the-art approaches.

AI.title_translation: MoAPT：用于视觉语言模型的对抗性提示调优混合
AI.tldr: 现有模型在面对多种对抗性攻击时，单一可学习文本提示的泛化能力不足，容易导致过拟合。为解决此问题，本文提出了一种名为MoAPT（Mixture of Adversarial Prompt Tuning）的对抗性调优方法，通过学习混合文本提示来获得更鲁棒的文本特征。此外，还提出了一种基于对抗性图像的条件权重路由器来预测多个学习提示的混合权重，以获得与不同对抗性图像特征匹配的特定于样本的混合文本特征。实验表明，MoAPT在各种设置下的11个数据集上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 大型预训练视觉语言模型（VLMs）虽然泛化能力强，但容易受到对抗性样本的攻击，存在安全风险。现有的对抗性提示调优方法在面对多种对抗性攻击时，单一可学习文本提示的泛化能力不足，容易导致过拟合。
AI.method: 提出一种名为MoAPT（Mixture of Adversarial Prompt Tuning）的对抗性调优方法，学习混合文本提示以获得更鲁棒的文本特征。提出一种基于对抗性图像的条件权重路由器，预测多个学习提示的混合权重，以获得特定于样本的混合文本特征。
AI.result: 在11个数据集和不同设置下的广泛实验表明，MoAPT在对抗性鲁棒性方面优于最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: MoAPT通过学习混合文本提示并利用条件权重路由器，能够有效提高VLMs在面对多种对抗性攻击时的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
AI.translation: 大型预训练视觉语言模型（VLMs）表现出出色的泛化能力，但仍然极易受到对抗性样本的攻击，构成潜在的安全风险。为了提高VLMs对抗对抗性样本的鲁棒性，提出了对抗性提示调优方法，在不改变模型参数的情况下，使文本特征与对抗性图像特征对齐。然而，当面对各种对抗性攻击时，单一可学习的文本提示泛化能力不足，无法很好地与所有对抗性图像特征对齐，最终导致过拟合。为了解决这一挑战，在本文中，我们通过实验发现，增加学习到的提示数量比简单地延长单个提示的长度能带来更大的鲁棒性提升。基于这一观察，我们提出了一种名为	extbf{混合对抗性提示调优（MoAPT）}的对抗性调优方法，以增强VLMs对抗各种对抗性攻击的泛化能力。MoAPT旨在学习混合文本提示以获得更鲁棒的文本特征。为了进一步增强适应性，我们提出了一种基于对抗性图像的条件权重路由器，用于预测多个学习提示的混合权重，这有助于获得与不同对抗性图像特征对齐的特定于样本的混合文本特征。在不同设置下的广泛实验表明，我们的方法在对抗性鲁棒性方面优于最先进的方法。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为MoAPT（Mixture of Adversarial Prompt Tuning）的新方法，旨在提高大型预训练视觉语言模型（VLMs）在面对各种对抗性攻击时的鲁棒性。与仅使用单一提示的方法不同，MoAPT通过学习多个提示的混合体来增强模型的泛化能力。此外，它还引入了一个条件权重路由器，可以根据输入的对抗性图像动态地调整不同提示的权重，从而生成更具适应性的文本特征。实验结果表明，MoAPT在多项基准测试中均取得了优于现有技术的性能。
AI.keywords: 对抗性攻击, 视觉语言模型, 提示调优, 鲁棒性, 混合提示
AI.comments: 该研究有效地解决了现有VLMs在对抗性攻击下的脆弱性问题，通过引入“提示混合”和“条件权重路由器”的创新性方法，显著提升了模型的鲁棒性和泛化能力。实验设计全面，结果令人信服，为未来研究提供了有价值的参考。

title: Breaking the Performance Ceiling in Reinforcement Learning requires Inference Strategies
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) systems have countless applications, from energy-grid management to protein design. However, such real-world scenarios are often extremely difficult, combinatorial in nature, and require complex coordination between multiple agents. This level of complexity can cause even state-of-the-art RL systems, trained until convergence, to hit a performance ceiling which they are unable to break out of with zero-shot inference. Meanwhile, many digital or simulation-based applications allow for an inference phase that utilises a specific time and compute budget to explore multiple attempts before outputting a final solution. In this work, we show that such an inference phase employed at execution time, and the choice of a corresponding inference strategy, are key to breaking the performance ceiling observed in complex multi-agent RL problems. Our main result is striking: we can obtain up to a 126% and, on average, a 45% improvement over the previous state-of-the-art across 17 tasks, using only a couple seconds of extra wall-clock time during execution. We also demonstrate promising compute scaling properties, supported by over 60k experiments, making it the largest study on inference strategies for complex RL to date. Our experimental data and code are available at https://sites.google.com/view/inference-strategies-rl.

AI.title_translation: 打破强化学习性能上限需要推理策略
AI.tldr: 强化学习在复杂多智能体问题中会遇到性能瓶颈，但通过在执行时采用推理策略，可以在少量额外计算时间内显著提高性能，平均提升45%，最高达126%。
AI.motivation: 现实世界中的强化学习应用（如能源网格管理、蛋白质设计）通常非常复杂，具有组合性和多智能体协调的特点，这会导致现有最先进的强化学习系统在收敛后达到性能上限，无法通过零样本推理来突破。
AI.method: 在执行时引入推理阶段，并采用相应的推理策略来探索多种解决方案，以此来突破复杂多智能体强化学习中观察到的性能瓶颈。
AI.result: 通过采用推理策略，在17个任务上取得了显著的性能提升，平均提升45%，最高提升126%，而执行时间仅增加了几秒。该研究还通过超过6万次实验验证了其计算扩展性，是迄今为止关于复杂强化学习推理策略的最大规模研究。
AI.conclusion: 在执行时采用推理策略是突破复杂多智能体强化学习性能瓶颈的关键因素，能够以较低的额外计算成本带来显著的性能提升。
AI.translation: 强化学习（RL）系统在能源网格管理到蛋白质设计等领域有着广泛的应用。然而，这些真实世界的场景通常非常困难，具有组合性质，并且需要多个智能体之间的复杂协调。这种复杂的程度会导致即使是最先进的RL系统，在训练到收敛后，也会达到一个性能上限，无法通过零样本推理来突破。与此同时，许多数字或基于仿真的应用允许在推理阶段利用特定的时间和计算预算来探索多种尝试，然后输出最终解决方案。在这项工作中，我们表明，在执行时采用这样的推理阶段，以及选择相应的推理策略，是突破复杂多智能体RL问题中观察到的性能瓶颈的关键。我们的主要结果非常显著：与之前最先进的方法相比，在17个任务上，我们仅用了几秒钟的额外实际运行时间，就获得了高达126%的改进，平均提升了45%。我们还展示了有希望的计算扩展性，该研究得到了超过6万次实验的支持，使其成为迄今为止关于复杂RL推理策略的最大规模研究。我们的实验数据和代码可在https://sites.google.com/view/inference-strategies-rl获取。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种在执行时利用推理策略来突破强化学习在复杂多智能体任务中性能瓶颈的方法。实验表明，该方法能在极小的额外计算时间内带来显著的性能提升，平均提升45%，最高达126%，并且具有良好的计算扩展性。
AI.keywords: 强化学习,推理策略,性能瓶颈,多智能体,零样本推理
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地将推理阶段引入到强化学习的执行过程中，解决了现有方法在复杂场景下的性能瓶颈问题。其核心创新在于证明了推理策略对于打破性能上限的重要性，并且在实际应用中取得了显著的性能提升，同时保持了较低的计算成本。研究规模大，实验充分，为未来在该领域的研究提供了坚实的基础。然而，对于推理策略的具体选择和设计，以及其在不同类型复杂任务上的泛化能力，仍有待进一步探索。

title: Conflicting Biases at the Edge of Stability: Norm versus Sharpness Regularization
summary: A widely believed explanation for the remarkable generalization capacities of overparameterized neural networks is that the optimization algorithms used for training induce an implicit bias towards benign solutions. To grasp this theoretically, recent works examine gradient descent and its variants in simplified training settings, often assuming vanishing learning rates. These studies reveal various forms of implicit regularization, such as $\ell_1$-norm minimizing parameters in regression and max-margin solutions in classification. Concurrently, empirical findings show that moderate to large learning rates exceeding standard stability thresholds lead to faster, albeit oscillatory, convergence in the so-called Edge-of-Stability regime, and induce an implicit bias towards minima of low sharpness (norm of training loss Hessian). In this work, we argue that a comprehensive understanding of the generalization performance of gradient descent requires analyzing the interaction between these various forms of implicit regularization. We empirically demonstrate that the learning rate balances between low parameter norm and low sharpness of the trained model. We furthermore prove for diagonal linear networks trained on a simple regression task that neither implicit bias alone minimizes the generalization error. These findings demonstrate that focusing on a single implicit bias is insufficient to explain good generalization, and they motivate a broader view of implicit regularization that captures the dynamic trade-off between norm and sharpness induced by non-negligible learning rates.

AI.title_translation: 稳定性边缘的冲突偏差：范数与锐度正则化
AI.tldr: 在优化深度神经网络时，学习率的大小会影响模型泛化能力。较低的学习率倾向于使参数范数最小化，而较高的学习率（在稳定性边缘）则倾向于使训练损失的Hessian矩阵的范数（即锐度）最小化。这两种正则化形式之间存在权衡，单独考虑任何一种都无法完全解释模型的泛化能力，需要综合考虑它们之间的动态权衡。
AI.motivation: 理解过参数化神经网络为何具有出色的泛化能力，特别是优化算法（如梯度下降）如何诱导隐式偏差，以寻求良性解。现有研究分别关注范数最小化和低锐度最小化，但需要理解这些不同形式的隐式正则化之间的相互作用。
AI.method: 通过实证研究，探讨学习率在模型参数范数和模型锐度之间的权衡。对角线性网络在简单回归任务上的训练进行理论证明，以验证单独的隐式偏差是否足以最小化泛化误差。
AI.result: 实证表明，学习率的大小在所训练模型的低参数范数和低锐度之间取得平衡。理论证明，对于简单的回归任务，单独的范数最小化或锐度最小化都无法最小化泛化误差。
AI.conclusion: 单一的隐式偏差（如低参数范数或低锐度）不足以解释深度神经网络的良好泛化能力。需要一种更广泛的视角来理解隐式正则化，该视角能够捕捉由非可忽略学习率引起的范数与锐度之间的动态权衡。
AI.translation: 一种被广泛接受的解释是，过参数化神经网络出色的泛化能力源于训练所用的优化算法诱导了对良性解的隐式偏差。为了在理论上理解这一点，近期的研究考察了梯度下降及其变种在简化的训练设置中的行为，通常假设学习率趋近于零。这些研究揭示了各种形式的隐式正则化，例如回归中的$\ell_1$-范数最小化参数和分类中的最大间隔解。与此同时，实证结果表明，在中高学习率（超出标准的稳定性阈值）下，所谓的“稳定性边缘”区域可以实现更快但有振荡的收敛，并诱导一种对低锐度（训练损失Hessian矩阵的范数）解的隐式偏差。在本研究中，我们认为，全面理解梯度下降的泛化性能需要分析这些不同形式的隐式正则化之间的相互作用。我们通过实证证明，学习率在低参数范数和低锐度之间取得平衡。此外，我们证明了对于在简单回归任务上训练的对角线性网络，单独的隐式偏差无法最小化泛化误差。这些发现表明，仅关注单一隐式偏差不足以解释良好的泛化能力，并促使人们对隐式正则化形成更广泛的看法，以捕捉由非可忽略学习率引起的范数与锐度之间的动态权衡。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了在训练过参数化神经网络时，梯度下降算法诱导的两种主要隐式偏差——参数范数最小化和损失函数锐度最小化——之间的相互作用。研究发现，学习率的大小在两者之间起着关键的权衡作用：较低的学习率倾向于减小参数范数，而较高的学习率（在稳定性边缘）则倾向于减小损失函数的锐度。通过理论和实证分析，论文证明了单独依赖任何一种偏差都无法充分解释模型的泛化能力，强调了理解和利用这两种偏差之间的动态权衡对于实现优异泛化性能的重要性。
AI.keywords: 隐式偏差, 梯度下降, 学习率, 参数范数, 损失锐度
AI.comments: 该研究对理解深度学习模型的泛化能力提供了新的视角，强调了隐式偏差的动态权衡而非单一因素的重要性。实证和理论结合的方法增加了结论的说服力。然而，研究主要集中在对角线性网络和简单回归任务上，其结论在更复杂的网络结构和任务上的普适性仍需进一步验证。

title: VAEER: Visual Attention-Inspired Emotion Elicitation Reasoning
comments: Currently under review as conference paper
summary: Images shared online strongly influence emotions and public well-being. Understanding the emotions an image elicits is therefore vital for fostering healthier and more sustainable digital communities, especially during public crises. We study Visual Emotion Elicitation (VEE), predicting the set of emotions that an image evokes in viewers. We introduce VAEER, an interpretable multi-label VEE framework that combines attention-inspired cue extraction with knowledge-grounded reasoning. VAEER isolates salient visual foci and contextual signals, aligns them with structured affective knowledge, and performs per-emotion inference to yield transparent, emotion-specific rationales. Across three heterogeneous benchmarks, including social imagery and disaster-related photos, VAEER achieves state-of-the-art results with up to 19% per-emotion improvements and a 12.3% average gain over strong CNN and VLM baselines. Our findings highlight interpretable multi-label emotion elicitation as a scalable foundation for responsible visual media analysis and emotionally sustainable online ecosystems.
comment: Currently under review as conference paper

AI.title_translation: VAEER：视觉注意力启发的表情唤起推理
AI.tldr: VAEER是一个新的、可解释的视觉情感唤起模型，它使用注意力机制和知识推理来预测图像引起的情绪，并在多个数据集上取得了优于现有CNN和VLM基线的结果。
AI.motivation: 在线分享的图像强烈影响情感和公众福祉，因此理解图像唤起的情绪对于促进更健康、更可持续的数字社区至关重要，尤其是在公共危机期间。
AI.method: VAEER是一个可解释的多标签VEE框架，它结合了注意力启发式线索提取和知识驱动的推理。该方法分离出显著的视觉焦点和上下文信号，将它们与结构化的情感知识对齐，并进行每种情感的推理，以产生透明的、特定于情感的解释。
AI.result: 在三个异构基准（包括社交图像和灾难相关照片）上，VAEER取得了最先进的结果，实现了高达19%的每种情感的提升和比强大的CNN和VLM基线高出12.3%的平均增益。
AI.conclusion: 可解释的多标签情感唤起是负责任的视觉媒体分析和情感可持续在线生态系统的可扩展基础。
AI.translation: 在线分享的图像强烈影响情感和公众福祉。因此，理解图像在观看者身上唤起的情绪对于在公共危机期间培养更健康、更可持续的数字社区至关重要。我们研究视觉情感唤起（VEE），预测图像所唤起的情绪集合。我们引入了VAEER，一个可解释的多标签VEE框架，它结合了注意力启发式线索提取和知识驱动的推理。VAEER分离出显著的视觉焦点和上下文信号，将它们与结构化的情感知识对齐，并进行每种情感的推理，以产生透明的、特定于情感的解释。在三个异构基准（包括社交图像和与灾难相关的照片）上，VAEER取得了最先进的结果，实现了高达19%的每种情感的提升和比强大的CNN和VLM基线高出12.3%的平均增益。我们的研究结果强调了可解释的多标签情感唤起是负责任的视觉媒体分析和情感可持续在线生态系统的可扩展基础。
AI.summary: 本文提出了VAEER，一个用于视觉情感唤起（VEE）的可解释多标签框架。VAEER通过结合注意力启发式线索提取和知识驱动推理，识别视觉焦点和上下文信号，并将其与情感知识对齐，以提供透明的情感推理。实验证明，VAEER在多个基准上优于现有方法，实现了最先进的性能。
AI.keywords: 视觉情感唤起, VAEER, 注意力启发, 知识推理, 可解释性
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个结合了注意力启发式线索提取和知识驱动推理的可解释性多标签VEE框架VAEER。其重要性在于为负责任的视觉媒体分析和情感可持续的在线生态系统奠定了基础。局限性未在摘要中明确提及，但可解释性的深度学习模型通常在泛化性上存在挑战。

title: ViStoryBench: Comprehensive Benchmark Suite for Story Visualization
summary: Story visualization aims to generate coherent image sequences that faithfully depict a narrative and align with character references. Despite progress in generative models, existing benchmarks are narrow in scope, often limited to short prompts, lacking character references, or single-image cases, and fail to capture real-world storytelling complexity. This hinders a nuanced understanding of model capabilities and limitations. We present \textbf{ViStoryBench}, a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate story visualization models across diverse narrative structures, visual styles, and character settings. The benchmark features richly annotated multi-shot scripts derived from curated stories spanning literature, film, and folklore. Large language models assist in story summarization and script generation, with all outputs human-verified to ensure coherence and fidelity. Character references are carefully curated to maintain intra-story consistency across varying artistic styles. To enable thorough evaluation, ViStoryBench introduces a set of automated metrics that assess character consistency, style similarity, prompt alignment, aesthetic quality, and generation artifacts such as copy-paste behavior. These metrics are validated through human studies, and used to benchmark a broad range of open-source and commercial models. ViStoryBench offers a multi-dimensional evaluation suite that facilitates systematic analysis and fosters future progress in visual storytelling.

AI.title_translation: ViStoryBench：全面的故事可视化基准测试套件
AI.tldr: 研究人员创建了ViStoryBench，一个更全面、更复杂的基准测试工具，用于评估故事生成AI模型，它包含了更真实的脚本、角色一致性检查和一套新的评估指标，以更好地理解这些模型的优缺点。
AI.motivation: 现有的基准测试范围狭窄，通常局限于短提示、缺乏角色参考或仅为单张图像，未能捕捉真实世界叙事的复杂性，阻碍了对模型能力和局限性的细致理解。
AI.method: 构建了包含多镜头脚本的综合性基准，这些脚本来源于文学、电影和民间故事；利用大型语言模型辅助故事总结和脚本生成，并经过人工验证；引入了一套自动评估指标来衡量角色一致性、风格相似度、提示对齐、美学质量和生成伪影；通过人类研究验证了这些指标。
AI.result: 对一系列开源和商业模型进行了基准测试。
AI.conclusion: ViStoryBench提供了一个多维度的评估套件，有助于对视觉叙事模型进行系统分析并促进未来的发展。
AI.translation: 故事可视化旨在生成忠实描绘叙事并与角色参考一致的连贯图像序列。尽管生成模型取得了进展，但现有的基准测试范围狭窄，通常仅限于短提示、缺乏角色参考或仅为单张图像，未能捕捉真实世界叙事的复杂性。这阻碍了对模型能力和局限性的细致理解。我们提出了\textbf{ViStoryBench}，一个综合性基准，旨在跨越不同的叙事结构、视觉风格和角色设置来评估故事可视化模型。该基准包含源自精选文学、电影和民间故事的丰富注释的多镜头脚本。大型语言模型协助故事总结和脚本生成，所有输出都经过人工验证以确保连贯性和保真度。角色参考经过精心策划，以在不同艺术风格中保持故事内部的一致性。为了实现彻底的评估，ViStoryBench引入了一套自动指标，用于评估角色一致性、风格相似度、提示对齐、美学质量以及诸如复制粘贴行为等生成伪影。这些指标通过人类研究得到验证，并用于对一系列开源和商业模型进行基准测试。ViStoryBench提供了一个多维度的评估套件，有助于系统的分析并促进视觉叙事的未来发展。
AI.summary: ViStoryBench是一个全面的基准测试套件，旨在评估故事可视化模型在不同叙事结构、视觉风格和角色设置下的性能。它包含从精选故事中提取并由大型语言模型辅助生成、经人工验证的多镜头脚本，并引入了一套自动化的多维度评估指标（如角色一致性、风格相似度等），以促进对视觉叙事模型的系统分析和进步。
AI.keywords: 故事可视化, 基准测试, 角色一致性, 叙事结构, 评估指标
AI.comments: 该基准的创新之处在于其全面性，它涵盖了叙事结构、视觉风格和角色设置等多个维度，并引入了自动化的多维度评估指标，解决了现有基准范围狭窄的问题，对推动故事可视化领域的发展至关重要。

title: Evaluating Large Language Models in Crisis Detection: A Real-World Benchmark from Psychological Support Hotlines
comments: Preprint. Submitted to IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics (under review)
summary: Psychological support hotlines serve as critical lifelines for crisis intervention but encounter significant challenges due to rising demand and limited resources. Large language models (LLMs) offer potential support in crisis assessments, yet their effectiveness in emotionally sensitive, real-world clinical settings remains underexplored. We introduce PsyCrisisBench, a comprehensive benchmark of 540 annotated transcripts from the Hangzhou Psychological Assistance Hotline, assessing four key tasks: mood status recognition, suicidal ideation detection, suicide plan identification, and risk assessment. 64 LLMs across 15 model families (including closed-source such as GPT, Claude, Gemini and open-source such as Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek) were evaluated using zero-shot, few-shot, and fine-tuning paradigms. LLMs showed strong results in suicidal ideation detection (F1=0.880), suicide plan identification (F1=0.779), and risk assessment (F1=0.907), with notable gains from few-shot prompting and fine-tuning. Compared to trained human operators, LLMs achieved comparable or superior performance on suicide plan identification and risk assessment, while humans retained advantages on mood status recognition and suicidal ideation detection. Mood status recognition remained challenging (max F1=0.709), likely due to missing vocal cues and semantic ambiguity. Notably, a fine-tuned 1.5B-parameter model (Qwen2.5-1.5B) outperformed larger models on mood and suicidal ideation tasks. LLMs demonstrate performance broadly comparable to trained human operators in text-based crisis assessment, with complementary strengths across task types. PsyCrisisBench provides a robust, real-world evaluation framework to guide future model development and ethical deployment in clinical mental health.
comment: Preprint. Submitted to IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics (under review)

AI.title_translation: 评估大型语言模型在危机检测中的表现：来自心理支持热线的真实世界基准
AI.tldr: 研究者创建了PsyCrisisBench，用540条真实心理热线数据测试了64个LLMs在危机检测（如自杀意念、风险评估）中的能力。LLMs在许多任务上表现与人类相当或更好，但情绪识别仍是弱项。微调和少样本学习有效提升了性能，证明了LLMs可作为文本危机评估的有力工具。
AI.motivation: 心理支持热线在应对不断增长的需求和有限资源时面临挑战，而LLMs在危机评估中显示出潜力，但其在情感敏感的真实临床环境中的有效性尚未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 引入PsyCrisisBench基准（包含540条标注的杭州心理援助热线记录），评估了64个LLM（来自15个模型家族）在四项关键任务（情绪状态识别、自杀意念检测、自杀计划识别、风险评估）上的表现，测试范式包括零样本、少样本和微调。
AI.result: LLMs在自杀意念检测（F1=0.880）、自杀计划识别（F1=0.779）和风险评估（F1=0.907）中表现强劲，少样本提示和微调带来了显著提升。LLMs在自杀计划识别和风险评估方面达到或超过了受训人工操作员的性能，但在情绪状态识别和自杀意念检测方面人工操作员仍有优势。情绪状态识别仍然具有挑战性（最高F1=0.709）。一个微调的1.5B参数模型（Qwen2.5-1.5B）在情绪和自杀意念任务上优于更大的模型。
AI.conclusion: LLMs在基于文本的危机评估中表现出与受训人工操作员大致相当的性能，且在不同任务类型上具有互补优势。PsyCrisisBench为未来模型开发和临床心理健康领域的伦理部署提供了一个稳健的评估框架。
AI.translation: 心理支持热线是危机干预的关键生命线，但由于需求增加和资源有限，它们面临着重大挑战。大型语言模型（LLMs）在危机评估中提供了潜在支持，但其在情感敏感的真实临床环境中的有效性仍有待探索。我们引入了PsyCrisisBench，一个包含来自杭州心理援助热线的540条标注记录的综合基准，用于评估四项关键任务：情绪状态识别、自杀意念检测、自杀计划识别和风险评估。使用零样本、少样本和微调范式，我们评估了来自15个模型家族的64个LLMs（包括闭源的如GPT、Claude、Gemini以及开源的如Llama、Qwen、DeepSeek）。LLMs在自杀意念检测（F1=0.880）、自杀计划识别（F1=0.779）和风险评估（F1=0.907）中表现出强劲结果，少样本提示和微调带来了显著提升。与受训人工操作员相比，LLMs在自杀计划识别和风险评估方面取得了相当或更优的性能，而在情绪状态识别和自杀意念检测方面，人类仍保持优势。情绪状态识别仍然具有挑战性（最高F1=0.709），可能是由于缺少语音线索和语义模糊。值得注意的是，一个微调的1.5B参数模型（Qwen2.5-1.5B）在情绪和自杀意念任务上超越了更大的模型。LLMs在基于文本的危机评估中表现出与受训人工操作员大致相当的性能，且在不同任务类型上具有互补优势。PsyCrisisBench为指导未来模型开发和在临床心理健康领域的伦理部署提供了一个稳健的真实世界评估框架。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了PsyCrisisBench，一个包含540条真实心理援助热线记录的基准数据集，用于评估64个大型语言模型（LLMs）在危机检测四项关键任务上的表现。评估结果显示，LLMs在自杀意念检测和风险评估等任务上表现出色，性能可与人类操作员匹敌或超越，但情绪状态识别仍是难点。研究强调了LLMs在文本危机评估中的潜力及其与人类专长的互补性。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 危机检测, 心理支持热线, 基准测试, PsyCrisisBench
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地构建了真实世界心理援助热线的基准数据集PsyCrisisBench，用于系统评估LLMs在危机检测任务中的能力。其重要性在于首次在临床敏感场景下对大量主流LLM进行了全面、多范式的测试。局限性可能在于仅基于文本信息，忽略了电话沟通中的关键声学线索。

title: Do Neural Networks Need Gradient Descent to Generalize? A Theoretical Study
summary: Conventional wisdom attributes the mysterious generalization abilities of overparameterized neural networks to gradient descent (and its variants). The recent volume hypothesis challenges this view: it posits that these generalization abilities persist even when gradient descent is replaced by Guess & Check (G&C), i.e., by drawing weight settings until one that fits the training data is found. The validity of the volume hypothesis for wide and deep neural networks remains an open question. In this paper, we theoretically investigate this question for matrix factorization (with linear and non-linear activation)--a common testbed in neural network theory. We first prove that generalization under G&C deteriorates with increasing width, establishing what is, to our knowledge, the first case where G&C is provably inferior to gradient descent. Conversely, we prove that generalization under G&C improves with increasing depth, revealing a stark contrast between wide and deep networks, which we further validate empirically. These findings suggest that even in simple settings, there may not be a simple answer to the question of whether neural networks need gradient descent to generalize well.

AI.title_translation: 神经网络是否需要梯度下降才能泛化？一项理论研究
AI.tldr: 研究表明，在某些情况下，梯度下降对于神经网络的泛化能力至关重要，尤其是在网络宽度增加时，而深度则可能提升泛化能力，这与之前的猜想（即即使没有梯度下降也能泛化）形成对比。
AI.motivation: 挑战了神经网络泛化能力归因于梯度下降的传统观点，并探讨了在不使用梯度下降的情况下（例如通过猜测和检查）神经网络是否仍能泛化。
AI.method: 对矩阵分解（包括线性激活和非线性激活）进行了理论研究，并进行了实证验证，以分析宽度和深度对神经网络泛化能力的影响。
AI.result: 证明了在猜测和检查（G&C）下，泛化能力会随着网络宽度的增加而恶化，这是G&C在理论上不如梯度下降的首个案例。相反，证明了在G&C下，泛化能力会随着网络深度的增加而提高，这在理论和实证上都得到了验证。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，即使在简单的设置中，神经网络是否需要梯度下降才能很好地泛化，答案也并非简单明了，并且网络结构（宽度和深度）对其泛化能力有显著影响。
AI.translation: 传统的观点将过参数化神经网络的神秘泛化能力归因于梯度下降（及其变体）。最近的“体量假设”挑战了这一观点：它认为，即使梯度下降被“猜测与检查”（G&C）所取代——即通过抽取权重设置直到找到一个适合训练数据的设置——这些泛化能力也依然存在。体量假设对于宽而深的神经网络的有效性仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。在本文中，我们从理论上研究了这个问题，针对矩阵分解（具有线性和非线性激活）——这是神经网络理论中一个常见的测试平台。我们首先证明，在G&C下，泛化能力随着宽度的增加而恶化，从而确定了我们所知的第一个G&C在理论上不如梯度下降的案例。相反，我们证明了在G&C下，泛化能力随着深度的增加而提高，揭示了宽网络和深网络之间的显著对比，并且我们通过实证进一步验证了这一点。这些发现表明，即使在简单的设置中，神经网络是否需要梯度下降才能很好地泛化，答案也并非简单明了。
AI.summary: 本研究从理论上探讨了神经网络泛化能力是否必须依赖于梯度下降。通过对矩阵分解模型的研究，发现当网络宽度增加时，梯度下降对于泛化至关重要，而增加网络深度则有助于在不使用梯度下降的情况下（通过猜测与检查）提升泛化能力，这与之前的“体量假设”有所不同，并为理解神经网络的泛化机制提供了新的视角。
AI.keywords: 神经网络, 泛化, 梯度下降, 体量假设, 猜测与检查
AI.comments: 这项研究对神经网络泛化理论做出了重要贡献，挑战了普遍存在的观点，并提供了新的理论见解。研究结果具有重要的理论意义，但也可能存在局限性，例如模型简化（矩阵分解）和理论分析的适用范围。未来的研究可以探索更复杂的网络结构和实际应用场景。

title: LaF-GRPO: In-Situ Navigation Instruction Generation for the Visually Impaired via GRPO with LLM-as-Follower Reward
summary: Navigation instruction generation for visually impaired (VI) individuals (NIG-VI) is critical yet relatively underexplored. This study focuses on generating precise, in-situ, step-by-step navigation instructions that are practically usable for VI users. Specifically, we propose LaF-GRPO (LLM-as-Follower GRPO), where an LLM simulates VI user responses to navigation instructions, thereby providing feedback rewards to guide the post-training of a Vision-Language Model (VLM). This enhances instruction accuracy and usability while reducing costly real-world data collection needs. To address the scarcity of dedicated benchmarks in this field, we introduce NIG4VI, a 27k-sample open-source dataset to facilitate training and evaluation. It comprises diverse navigation scenarios with accurate spatial coordinates, supporting detailed and open-ended in-situ instruction generation. Experiments on NIG4VI demonstrate the effectiveness of LaF-GRPO through quantitative metrics (e.g., Zero-(LaF-GRPO) boosts BLEU 14\%; SFT+(LaF-GRPO) METEOR 0.542 vs. GPT-4o 0.323), and qualitative analysis further confirms that our method yields more intuitive and safer instructions.

title: TRiSM for Agentic AI: A Review of Trust, Risk, and Security Management in LLM-based Agentic Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Agentic AI systems, built upon large language models (LLMs) and deployed in multi-agent configurations, are redefining intelligence, autonomy, collaboration, and decision-making across enterprise and societal domains. This review presents a structured analysis of Trust, Risk, and Security Management (TRiSM) in the context of LLM-based Agentic Multi-Agent Systems (AMAS). We begin by examining the conceptual foundations of Agentic AI and highlight its architectural distinctions from traditional AI agents. We then adapt and extend the AI TRiSM framework for Agentic AI, structured around key pillars: \textit{ Explainability, ModelOps, Security, Privacy} and \textit{their Lifecycle Governance}, each contextualized to the challenges of AMAS. A risk taxonomy is proposed to capture the unique threats and vulnerabilities of Agentic AI, ranging from coordination failures to prompt-based adversarial manipulation. To support practical assessment in Agentic AI works, we introduce two novel metrics: the Component Synergy Score (CSS), which quantifies the quality of inter-agent collaboration, and the Tool Utilization Efficacy (TUE), which evaluates the efficiency of tool use within agent workflows. We further discuss strategies for improving explainability in Agentic AI, as well as approaches to enhancing security and privacy through encryption, adversarial robustness, and regulatory compliance. The review concludes with a research roadmap for the responsible development and deployment of Agentic AI, highlighting key directions to align emerging systems with TRiSM principles-ensuring safety, transparency, and accountability in their operation.

title: Towards Practical Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis: A Lightweight and Interpretable Spiking Neural Model
summary: Early diagnosis of Alzheimer's Disease (AD), particularly at the mild cognitive impairment stage, is essential for timely intervention. However, this process faces significant barriers, including reliance on subjective assessments and the high cost of advanced imaging techniques. While deep learning offers automated solutions to improve diagnostic accuracy, its widespread adoption remains constrained due to high energy requirements and computational demands, particularly in resource-limited settings. Spiking neural networks (SNNs) provide a promising alternative, as their brain-inspired design is well-suited to model the sparse and event-driven patterns characteristic of neural degeneration in AD. These networks offer the potential for developing interpretable, energy-efficient diagnostic tools. Despite their advantages, existing SNNs often suffer from limited expressiveness and challenges in stable training, which reduce their effectiveness in handling complex medical tasks. To address these shortcomings, we introduce FasterSNN, a hybrid neural architecture that combines biologically inspired Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (LIF) neurons with region-adaptive convolution and multi-scale spiking attention mechanisms. This approach facilitates efficient, sparse processing of 3D MRI data while maintaining high diagnostic accuracy. Experimental results on benchmark datasets reveal that FasterSNN delivers competitive performance with significantly enhanced efficiency and training stability, highlighting its potential for practical application in AD screening. Our source code is available at https://github.com/wuchangw/FasterSNN.

title: Scene-aware SAR ship detection guided by unsupervised sea-land segmentation
summary: DL based Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) ship detection has tremendous advantages in numerous areas. However, it still faces some problems, such as the lack of prior knowledge, which seriously affects detection accuracy. In order to solve this problem, we propose a scene-aware SAR ship detection method based on unsupervised sea-land segmentation. This method follows a classical two-stage framework and is enhanced by two models: the unsupervised land and sea segmentation module (ULSM) and the land attention suppression module (LASM). ULSM and LASM can adaptively guide the network to reduce attention on land according to the type of scenes (inshore scene and offshore scene) and add prior knowledge (sea land segmentation information) to the network, thereby reducing the network's attention to land directly and enhancing offshore detection performance relatively. This increases the accuracy of ship detection and enhances the interpretability of the model. Specifically, in consideration of the lack of land sea segmentation labels in existing deep learning-based SAR ship detection datasets, ULSM uses an unsupervised approach to classify the input data scene into inshore and offshore types and performs sea-land segmentation for inshore scenes. LASM uses the sea-land segmentation information as prior knowledge to reduce the network's attention to land. We conducted our experiments using the publicly available SSDD dataset, which demonstrated the effectiveness of our network.

title: Towards Pervasive Distributed Agentic Generative AI -- A State of The Art
summary: The rapid advancement of intelligent agents and Large Language Models (LLMs) is reshaping the pervasive computing field. Their ability to perceive, reason, and act through natural language understanding enables autonomous problem-solving in complex pervasive environments, including the management of heterogeneous sensors, devices, and data. This survey outlines the architectural components of LLM agents (profiling, memory, planning, and action) and examines their deployment and evaluation across various scenarios. Than it reviews computational and infrastructural advancements (cloud to edge) in pervasive computing and how AI is moving in this field. It highlights state-of-the-art agent deployment strategies and applications, including local and distributed execution on resource-constrained devices. This survey identifies key challenges of these agents in pervasive computing such as architectural, energetic and privacy limitations. It finally proposes what we called "Agent as a Tool", a conceptual framework for pervasive agentic AI, emphasizing context awareness, modularity, security, efficiency and effectiveness.

title: How Warm-Glow Alters the Usability of Technology
summary: As technology increasingly aligns with users' personal values, traditional models of usability, focused on functionality and specifically effectiveness, efficiency, and satisfaction, may not fully capture how people perceive and evaluate it. This study investigates how the warm-glow phenomenon, the positive feeling associated with doing good, shapes perceived usability. An experimental approach was taken in which participants evaluated a hypothetical technology under conditions designed to evoke either the intrinsic (i.e., personal fulfillment) or extrinsic (i.e., social recognition) dimensions of warm-glow. A Multivariate Analysis of Variance as well as subsequent follow-up analyses revealed that intrinsic warm-glow significantly enhances all dimensions of perceived usability, while extrinsic warm-glow selectively influences perceived effectiveness and satisfaction. These findings suggest that perceptions of usability extend beyond functionality and are shaped by how technology resonates with users' broader sense of purpose. We conclude by proposing that designers consider incorporating warm-glow into technology as a strategic design decision.

title: Paired Disjunctive Domination Number of Middle Graphs
summary: The concept of domination in graphs plays a central role in understanding structural properties and applications in network theory. In this study, we focus on the paired disjunctive domination number in the context of middle graphs, a transformation that captures both adjacency and incidence relations of the original graph. We begin by investigating this parameter for middle graphs of several special graph classes, including path graphs, cycle graphs, wheel graphs, complete graphs, complete bipartite graphs, star graphs, friendship graphs, and double star graphs. We then present general results by establishing lower and upper bounds for the paired disjunctive domination number in middle graphs of arbitrary graphs, with particular emphasis on trees. Additionally, we determine the exact value of the parameter for middle graphs obtained through the join operation. These findings contribute to the broader understanding of domination-type parameters in transformed graph structures and offer new insights into their combinatorial behavior.

title: Waterfall Model Simulation: A Systematic Mapping Study
summary: This paper systematically maps peer-reviewed research and graduate theses/dissertations that explicitly simulate the waterfall model. Following Petersen's mapping guidelines and Kitchenham's systematic literature review practices, major databases (ACM Digital Library, IEEE Xplore, Scopus, Springer, Google Scholar, and Web of Science) were searched for studies published between 2000-2024 using the title query ("simulation" OR "simulating") AND "waterfall". A PRISMA workflow guided the screening process, and approximately 9% of retrieved records met the inclusion criteria. A repeated extraction process captured methods, tools, venues, geography, publication years, comparative scope, and fidelity to Royce's original model; findings were synthesized thematically. Discrete-event simulation dominates (80%) compared to system dynamics (20%). Reported tools center on Simphony.NET (40%) and SimPy (20%), while 40% of studies omit tool details, limiting reproducibility. Research is distributed across Italy, Lebanon, India, Japan, and the United States; publication venues include 60% journals and 40% conferences. Sixty percent of studies are comparative, while 40% model only the waterfall approach. No study reproduces Royce's original model; all employ adaptations. The paper concludes by presenting a consolidated view of waterfall simulation research and recommending clearer model reporting, fuller tool disclosure, and wider adoption of open-source platforms.

title: Mirror Descent Policy Optimisation for Robust Constrained Markov Decision Processes
summary: Safety is an essential requirement for reinforcement learning systems. The newly emerging framework of robust constrained Markov decision processes allows learning policies that satisfy long-term constraints while providing guarantees under epistemic uncertainty. This paper presents mirror descent policy optimisation for robust constrained Markov decision processes, making use of policy gradient techniques to optimise both the policy (as a maximiser) and the transition kernel (as an adversarial minimiser) on the Lagrangian representing a constrained Markov decision process. Our proposed algorithm obtains an $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}\left(1/T^{1/3}\right)$ convergence rate in the sample-based robust constrained Markov decision process setting. The paper also contributes an algorithm for approximate gradient descent in the space of transition kernels, which is of independent interest for designing adversarial environments in general Markov decision processes. Experiments confirm the benefits of mirror descent policy optimisation in constrained and unconstrained optimisation, and significant improvements are observed in robustness tests when compared to baseline policy optimisation algorithms.

title: Echoes of AI: Investigating the Downstream Effects of AI Assistants on Software Maintainability
comments: Preprint of study preregistered at ICSME 2025 with In-Principal Acceptance. https://conf.researchr.org/track/icsme-2024/icsme-2024-registered-reports-track
summary: [Context] AI assistants, like GitHub Copilot and Cursor, are transforming software engineering. While several studies highlight productivity improvements, their impact on maintainability requires further investigation. [Objective] This study investigates whether co-development with AI assistants affects software maintainability, specifically how easily other developers can evolve the resulting source code. [Method] We conducted a two-phase controlled experiment involving 151 participants, 95% of whom were professional developers. In Phase 1, participants added a new feature to a Java web application, with or without AI assistance. In Phase 2, a randomized controlled trial, new participants evolved these solutions without AI assistance. [Results] Phase 2 revealed no significant differences in subsequent evolution with respect to completion time or code quality. Bayesian analysis suggests that any speed or quality improvements from AI use were at most small and highly uncertain. Observational results from Phase 1 corroborate prior research: using an AI assistant yielded a 30.7% median reduction in completion time, and habitual AI users showed an estimated 55.9% speedup. [Conclusions] Overall, we did not detect systematic maintainability advantages or disadvantages when other developers evolved code co-developed with AI assistants. Within the scope of our tasks and measures, we observed no consistent warning signs of degraded code-level maintainability. Future work should examine risks such as code bloat from excessive code generation and cognitive debt as developers offload more mental effort to assistants.

title: Verifiable Natural Language to Linear Temporal Logic Translation: A Benchmark Dataset and Evaluation Suite
summary: Empirical evaluation of state-of-the-art natural-language (NL) to temporal-logic (TL) translation systems reveals near-perfect performance on existing benchmarks. However, current studies measure only the accuracy of the translation of NL logic into formal TL, ignoring a system's capacity to ground atomic propositions into new scenarios or environments. This is a critical feature, necessary for the verification of resulting formulas in a concrete state space. Consequently, most NL-to-TL translation frameworks propose their own bespoke dataset in which the correct grounding is known a-priori, inflating performance metrics and neglecting the need for extensible, domain-general systems. In this paper, we introduce the Verifiable Linear Temporal Logic Benchmark ( VLTL-Bench), a unifying benchmark that measures verification and verifiability of automated NL-to-LTL translation. The dataset consists of four unique state spaces and thousands of diverse natural language specifications and corresponding formal specifications in temporal logic. Moreover, the benchmark contains sample traces to validate the temporal logic expressions. While the benchmark directly supports end-to-end evaluation, we observe that many frameworks decompose the process into i) lifting, ii) grounding, iii) translation, and iv) verification. The benchmark provides ground truths after each of these steps to enable researches to improve and evaluate different substeps of the overall problem. To encourage methodologically sound advances in verifiable NL-to-LTL translation approaches, we release VLTL-Bench here: https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/dubascudes/vltl bench.

title: Towards Practical GraphRAG: Efficient Knowledge Graph Construction and Hybrid Retrieval at Scale
summary: We propose a scalable and cost-efficient framework for deploying Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) in enterprise environments. While GraphRAG has shown promise for multi- hop reasoning and structured retrieval, its adoption has been limited due to reliance on expensive large language model (LLM)-based extraction and complex traversal strategies. To address these challenges, we introduce two core innovations: (1) an efficient knowledge graph construction pipeline that leverages dependency parsing to achieve 94% of LLM-based performance (61.87% vs. 65.83%) while significantly reducing costs and improving scalability; and (2) a hybrid retrieval strategy that fuses vector similarity with graph traversal using Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), maintaining separate embeddings for entities, chunks, and relations to enable multi-granular matching. We evaluate our framework on two enterprise datasets focused on legacy code migration and demonstrate improvements of up to 15% and 4.35% over vanilla vector retrieval baselines using LLM-as-Judge evaluation metrics. These results validate the feasibility of deploying GraphRAG in production enterprise environments, demonstrating that careful engineering of classical NLP techniques can match modern LLM-based approaches while enabling practical, cost-effective, and domain-adaptable retrieval-augmented reasoning at scale.

title: An Efficient Deep Learning Framework for Brain Stroke Diagnosis Using Computed Tomography Images
comments: Preprint version. Submitted for peer review
summary: Brain stroke is a leading cause of mortality and long-term disability worldwide, underscoring the need for precise and rapid prediction techniques. Computed Tomography (CT) scan is considered one of the most effective methods for diagnosing brain strokes. Most stroke classification techniques use a single slice-level prediction mechanism, requiring radiologists to manually select the most critical CT slice from the original CT volume. Although clinical evaluations are often used in traditional diagnostic procedures, machine learning (ML) has opened up new avenues for improving stroke diagnosis. To supplement traditional diagnostic techniques, this study investigates machine learning models for early brain stroke prediction using CT scan images. This research proposes a novel machine learning approach to brain stroke detection, focusing on optimizing classification performance with pre-trained deep learning models and advanced optimization strategies. Pre-trained models, including DenseNet201, InceptionV3, MobileNetV2, ResNet50, and Xception, are used for feature extraction. Feature engineering techniques, including BFO, PCA, and LDA, further enhance model performance. These features are then classified using machine learning algorithms, including SVC, RF, XGB, DT, LR, KNN, and GNB. Our experiments demonstrate that the combination of MobileNetV2, LDA, and SVC achieved the highest classification accuracy of 97.93%, significantly outperforming other model-optimizer-classifier combinations. The results underline the effectiveness of integrating lightweight pre-trained models with robust optimization and classification techniques for brain stroke diagnosis.
